text:
Residents:
Yuki (50s) works from home. Weekdays: at desk (bedroom_1) 9:00-17:30. Often out for lunch. Hobbies: gym, running, friends.
Nora (40s) works in town. Weekdays: out 8:00-17:30. Home evenings. Hobbies: napping, reading, sketching. Cares for dog.
Weekends: Both sleep in, errands midday, home rest of day.
Note: Nora was home sick on Thursday.

Object Locations & Movements:
Static Items (Walkthrough Tue 18:00):
- Balcony: Watering can on floor.
- Bathroom: Razor on sink; towels on rack.
- Bedroom 1 (Yuki): Desk has laptop, pen. Nightstand has book, tablet. Wardrobe had gym bag.
- Bedroom 2 (Nora): Desk has pencil case, sketchbook. Nightstand has book.
- Entry: Doormat, vacuum on floor. Hat, jacket, scarf, shoes on hook. Keys, wallet on table. Running shoes on rack.
- Kitchen: Dishes in cupboard/sink. Dog bowl on floor. Dog food in pantry.
- Living: Standard furniture items.

Dynamic Items (Current Status Thu 23:59):
- Bedroom 1: Yuki’s laptop, pen, water bottle on desk_b1. Yuki’s charger, phone on nightstand_b1.
- Bedroom 2: Nora’s phone on nightstand_b2.
- Living: Board game, blanket, book_nora, laptop_nora on coffee_table_l1/tv_stand_l1.
- Kitchen: Mugs, glasses, plates, water bottles on kitchen_table_k1. Knife, spatula in drawer_k_k1. Pan, pot in cupboard_k1.
- Entry: Keys_nora on entry_table_e1. Keys_yuki, dog_leash on entry_hook_e1. Shoes_yuki on entry_floor_e1.
- Bathroom: Skincare_nora in medicine_cabinet_ba1. Towel_nora on bathroom_shelf_ba1.

Inference:
Nora is home sick today. Her items (laptop, book, mug) are in the living room, suggesting she is resting there. Yuki is at their desk, likely working or winding down.
Items taken out of the house on Thursday:
- 08:00: Nora’s jacket, keys, phone, shoes, and the dog leash were removed. This indicates Nora left the house briefly (perhaps for a walk or errand) despite being sick, or Yuki took the dog out using Nora’s leash. However, since Yuki was home and Nora’s items returned by 12:00, it is more likely Yuki took the dog out using the shared leash, or Nora stepped out briefly. Given Nora is "home sick," Yuki likely took the dog out.
- 12:00: Nora’s items (jacket, keys, shoes, leash) returned to the entry.
- 20:00: No items removed. Both residents home.

Routine Adjustments:
- Dog leash: Usually on entry_hook_e1. Taken out for walks (by Yuki or Nora).
- Nora’s work items (laptop, bag): Usually in bedroom_2 or entry. Taken out for work on weekdays.
- Yuki’s work items (laptop): Usually on desk_b1. Stays home.
- Keys: Usually on entry_table_e1 or hook. Taken out when leaving.
